note: Tokelau is a territory within the Realm of New Zealand and its people are New Zealand citizens, so their passport is New Zealand's. The routes modelled are New Zealand's, for an application to the Department of Internal Affairs as from New Zealand; whether an application lodged from the islands pays New Zealand's fee or the fee from overseas is a lead.
